narrative: On the board. A foul sheet on the parlour table, the yard door open on Two Gentlemen, the pen on Berowne's name and not toward the door. On the board. The line dry, the sheet folded once, the play still going in the yard.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the line and did not go out to the yard to act.
